# v2026.10.46

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.46.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.46.md).

This release covers **8 pull requests, with thanks to 1 contributor.**

## Highlights

- The Invoices list can show the job's Shipped date, Case, Practitioner, Due date and custom fields. ([#276](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/276))
- The Xero card shows Xero call usage and the age of Flow's copy of Xero data, on any screen width. ([#300](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/300), [#303](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/303)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- A connected integration card shows the signed-in account and returns to Flow by itself. ([#273](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/273)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Saved views sit in the toolbar beside Group, Sort and Filter. ([#277](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/277))
- List toolbar controls share one height and keep clear of the tab line. ([#296](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/296))

## Changes

- The Invoices list can show the job's Shipped date, Case, Practitioner, Due date and custom fields. ([#276](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/276))
- The Xero card shows Xero call usage and the age of Flow's copy of Xero data. ([#300](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/300)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- A connected integration card shows the signed-in account and returns to Flow by itself. ([#273](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/273)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).

## Fixes

- Saved views sit in the toolbar beside Group, Sort and Filter. ([#277](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/277))
- List toolbar controls share one height and keep clear of the tab line. ([#296](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/296))
- The Xero card switches to its phone layout at the same width as every other screen. ([#303](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/303))
